U3-err-agent.key_denied.en: Your Mac's keychain didn't let Clauseo read, save or remove the API key. Press Allow on Your keychain, then choose Always Allow.
U3-err-agent.key_denied.hi: आपके Mac के कीचेन ने Clauseo को API कुंजी पढ़ने, सहेजने या हटाने नहीं दिया। Your keychain पर Allow दबाएँ, फिर Always Allow चुनें।
U3-err-agent.key_denied.note: agent.key_denied on the Mac: the keychain refused an API key's read, save or removal (stage E, dialogs off); while the keychain row needs allowing, the pointer (UC-1440) stands in its place; Windows' and Linux's line is U3-err-agent.key_denied.windows_linux
